title: Sennacherib defeats Merodach-Baladan and installs Bel-Ibni
summary: Sennacherib campaigns against Babylon and sets Bel-Ibni on the throne.
description: Sennacherib campaigns against Babylon and sets Bel-Ibni on the throne. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 3, row 703, p. 45; Table 2, row 703, p. 42).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 703 BC (Sennacherib year 2).

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 3, row 703, p. 45; Table 2, row 703, p. 42
chronologies.note: Sennacherib goes against Babylon, defeats Merodach-Baladan (who escapes to Elam), and installs Bel-Ibni as king.
